name: Tanaka Mamoru
source:
Assistant lab director at Okoshi Pharmaceutical, working directly under [url=/c73542]Kenji Osawa[/url]. His faithful commitment to his work has managed to earn Osawa's trust, acting as his confidant during the kidnapping case and in regards to the blackmail e-mails. He shares an undisclosed relationship with [url=/c73545]Hitomi Osawa[/url] and acts as her primary relay contact during the case.

[spoiler]In truth, Tanaka is a traitor to Okoshi Pharmaceutical and works directly under [url=/c74615]Alphard[/url] to steal the Ua antiviral. The former lover of Osawa's current wife, Ai, he resents Osawa and has worked with Alphard to undermine him.[/spoiler]
